During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]<ref name="Idol Intentions" /> that had been [[Declaration of a New Order|founded]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Inaugural Edition">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}} places the the [[Declaration of a New Order]] on 16:5:241 on the [[Great ReSynchronization]] calendar, which corresponds with [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> the '''wife''' of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Tyneir Renz]] was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] alongside their [[Tyneir Renz's son|son]] during a massacre at their [[Planet/Legends|homeworld]] [[Jiaan]], in retaliation for Renz's escape from the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. Though Renz had not arrived in [[Time/Legends|time]] to save his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] and son, he managed to save their daughter, [[Padija Anjeri]], from the massacre.<ref name="Idol Intentions" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tyneir Renz's wife was mentioned in Tyneir Renz's character statistics block in "[[Idol Intentions]]," a short story by [[Patricia A. Jackson]] in the [[February]] [[1997]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 12|twelfth issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'', a supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Idol Intentions" />
